linuxMaximumStart.traceCompleteness: All eight boundary and eight Euler step records were serialized before the failed numeric assertion.
linuxMaximumStart.causalLimit: The first differing observation is the first denoised result. The trace does not separate EPS input scaling, U-Net primitives and CFG arithmetic. Coexisting historical U-Net/CFG/Euler failures do not prove a common cause.

limitations: Windows and macOS pipeline captures match their own source bit for bit in this run; Linux maximum-start remains outside the unchanged prospective bound.
Linux's aggregate and eight aligned-helper tests were not executed after first-use failure. No missing result is counted as passed.
Source and product are separate runs with their own native images; a declared matching release does not imply identical binaries or hosts.
Actual ATen dispatch of the product remains unavailable. CPU feature flags report .NET intrinsic availability only.
The first assertion failure hides later assertions, not later captures; the complete trace audit measures them independently.
The 36 final comparisons repeat 12 semantic outputs three times and overlap the final records among the 64 distinct captures.
The 29 pipeline contracts test behavior and admission; their success is distinct from numerical source parity.
The implementation of blockers and any later work are outside this exact CI commit.
